verdict.rationale: Deel's employer-facing immigration offering covers team-level case management: a company-wide immigration tab, consolidated mobility operations across all entities on one platform, and both EOR-sponsored and own-entity work permits, plus renewals and offboarding. This goes clearly beyond single founder cases. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-case management, and detail on how the team dashboard handles many concurrent cases (bulk actions, reporting).

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: With Deel Immigration, you can consolidate your mobility operations in one place while getting the global support you need.
Deel clients using Deel's Global HRIS or Deel Payroll products can now manage their team's relocation across all entities on a single platform.
Get an overview of the company's mobility activities via the immigration tab; Get visa expiry reminders; Process visa renewals and transfers
Employer-sponsored work permits: Sponsor employees' work permits through your own entities.
EOR-sponsored work permits: Leverage Deel's entities to hire and sponsor visas.
